title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Banana Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Banana Ice from the JNP Bar Salts collection delivers a smooth, velvety, and brilliantly contrasting fruit profile. The familiar, mellow sweetness of ripe Banana provides a rich and creamy base that satisfies immediately. This warm, comforting foundation is then expertly matched with a crisp, frosty layer of Ice, creating a highly balanced and refreshing vape that never becomes overly sweet. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the chilled creaminess of Banana Ice, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the nostalgic Cherry Cola or the vibrant Strawberry Raspberry Cherry.
